note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L rows, not by website claims: outbound shipments on 2026-02-26 (Dighi ICD -> Le Havre, FR, HS 85361010, BOL 1026096) and 2026-02-27 (Nhava Sheva -> Brownsville US, HS 87089900, BOL 1083495), with further buyer aggregates to Korea and South Africa.
